plan:
we want to implement a 3 page system on this app. currently it just shows the seeded crates if seeded ran on init create which it did for me. what we want. is a home page that shows music news, and ai recomended crates (this is where we add more seeded crates). page 2 is following page, which we can also seed in fake users to follow as a test. and then page 3 is OUR profile page. page 4 is an about page for the app. lets fully build this out.

Goal: Turn Frisson from a single crate-browsing screen into a four-page app: Home (/, demo music news plus recommended crates), Following (/following, follow demo or real collectors and see their crates), Profile (/profile, the signed-in user's own profile) and About (/about), with a persistent follow system and demo content that reaches the owner's already-seeded database on the next API start without changing any existing data.

plan_changes.change: Request says '3 page system' but enumerates four pages; building all four.
plan_changes.why: The enumerated list is explicit, including 'page 4 is an about page'.

plan_changes.change: Demo content is applied at API start by a new idempotent step rather than added to db:seed.
plan_changes.why: Survey found db:seed is manual and wipes all crates, albums and tracks; the request assumed seeding ran on init.

plan_changes.change: CrateView moves from / to /shelf, with /crates/:id deep links.
plan_changes.why: Home takes / and recommended crates need a link target.

plan_changes.change: Manager added GET /api/me/suggested-collectors and a SEED_DEMO_DATA=false opt-out.
plan_changes.why: AC16 needs a suggestions source; the opt-out goes beyond the brief.

plan_changes.change: Fix round 1 also takes in four tester observations beyond AC10.
plan_changes.why: Feed names, profile crate links, singular labels and the stale store are real usability gaps on the new pages and share the same files.

Console for the whole run: only 3 'Failed to load resource: 401', matching the 3 GET /api/auth/me 401s while signed out. No other errors. Two PUT/DELETE 204 entries read 'FAILED: net::ERR_ABORTED' in the network log; server state confirms they succeeded, so this is a CDP artefact for empty bodies. Harness: with the pane hidden, a view transition can stall until a screenshot forces a frame; a click immediately after an SPA navigation missed twice and worked once a screenshot had been taken. 1280 emulation scales coordinates by 0.625, so ref clicks missed there; coordinate clicks verified by listener.

notes: AI recommended is a curated demo flag; the UI states no AI model is involved. Real model is out of scope.
News is fictional seeded data, not a live feed.
Manager: deleted demo tracks do not return, since tracks have no seed key. DELETE self-follow returns 204; AC12 leaves it open.

T1: ran prettier on generated 0005 snapshot and journal (whitespace only) so format:check passes; updated expected rows in 0003/0004 migration tests for the new NULL columns; tested on a synthetic 0004 DB, not a copy of the owner DB.
T2: profile key walk allows id on crates[] items only (crate ids are public; AC13 concerns user ids). crateCard.createdAt must be serialised with toISOString by services.
T6: client paths come from task text and were untested against a real server at the time; listNews and listRecommendedCrates have no path test; DemoTag has no own test.

T4: crate ids remain in feed and profile responses per the shared contract; collector summaries are checked recursively for id. Malformed username returns 400 when signed in, from shared param validation.

T3: its manual AC21 diff was invalid because the before dump queried a post-0005 column; tester must redo on a real copy. Demo names were checked from model knowledge only, without web search. Empty password login returns 400, not 401.

T8: count label is literal so a count of 1 reads 1 followers (harbormaster queued as a polish fix). ProfileView load() has no stale-response guard (pre-existing). RouterLink to crate route throws until T9 lands.
T7: scratch browser check at 320px used stubbed fetch and no App shell. AC9 CSS test only scans HomeView source, so AC9 needs a browser recheck after T9.
T5: no albumCount filter on recommended; AC8 minimums hold through seed data only, and an emptied ranked crate would show with 0 records.

T9: with a hidden browser pane the tab-click URL stalled until a screenshot forced a frame (view transition); probably harness, unconfirmed in a visible pane. Stale library store shows Crate not found for newer crates until reload.

T10: seeding defaults on outside production, so npm run dev seeds a developer DB. db:seed keeps users, follows and news. Compose checked with docker compose config only. Added a DEPLOY upgrade note beyond the brief.

Tester left low-severity items unfixed: stacked crate picker at 320/390 with 11+ crates; 7-card grid orphan; handles wrapping at the hyphen; plain Frisson titles on /list and not-found; placeholder-derived form names.
F1: a first load of an unknown crate id does one fetch, not two, reading force one reload as force only when the store was already loaded.
Retest: one real click on a recommended card count did not navigate; 3 later attempts did and the cause was not established. Possibly the hidden-pane view transition stall, unconfirmed.
Retest ran with NODE_ENV unset: built assets served by Fastify, not production mode. AC24 production-mode behaviour was covered in the first test pass.
The owner database has not been touched; it gets migration 0005 and demo data the next time the API starts on this branch.
Reporter write to report.md was refused by the harness; harbormaster saved its returned text verbatim. The run paused on a usage limit during the report stage, which inflates wall-clock time.
